subject: App works locally, doesn't deploy if I include SpiecEasi package

messages.author: 3bfdc3749ccc83f9
messages.subject: App works locally, doesn't deploy if I include SpiecEasi package
parts:
Hello,

I've been able to get an app to run locally that loads the following libraries at the start of the app.R file:
library(shiny)
library(xtable)
library(shinydashboard)
library(phyloseq)
library(Matrix)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(ggnet)
library(igraph)
library(gridExtra)
library(devtools)
library(SpiecEasi)

If I comment out the last line (library(SpiecEasi)), I can get the app to deploy. However, if I include it (and I would very much like to include it), I get the following error: Has anyone encountered something like this? I can't quite figure out what the problem is 

[2017-10-24T20:12:13.128500552+0000] Building R package: SpiecEasi (0.1.2)
/mnt/packages/build /mnt
Warning in untar2(tarfile, files, list, exdir, restore_times) :
  skipping pax global extended headers
* installing to library ‘/usr/local/lib/R/site-library’
* installing *source* package ‘SpiecEasi’ ...
** R
** data
*** moving datasets to lazyload DB
** inst
** preparing package for lazy loading
Error in loadNamespace(i, c(lib.loc, .libPaths()), versionCheck = vI[[i]]) : 
  there is no package called ‘phyloseq’
ERROR: lazy loading failed for package ‘SpiecEasi’
* removing ‘/usr/local/lib/R/site-library/SpiecEasi’
GET /v1/tasks/?filter=account_id:103158&filter=parent_id:493017465&count=100&offset=0 221ms
################################# End Task Log ################################# 
----- Deployment error -----
Error: Unhandled Exception: Child Task 493017465 failed: Error building image: Error building SpiecEasi (0.1.2). Build exited with non-zero status: 1

I'm not quite sure what the problem is with this specific package. Has anyone encountered anything similar? 
Thanks,
Stephen

messages.author: 299a5089d6c6c523
messages.subject: Re: App works locally, doesn't deploy if I include SpiecEasi package
parts:
SpiecEasi lists phyloseq as Suggests, not Imports, Depends or LinkingTo.
So when we build the graph of packages and start installing them, SpiecEasi appears to be installed before phyloseq.
And it seems that it will fail outright if phyloseq is not present.

I suggest opening an issue with the package author. Or forking it and adjusting the DESCRIPTION file and offering a pull request.

messages.author: 3495e675634ef195
messages.subject: Re: App works locally, doesn't deploy if I include SpiecEasi package
parts:
SpiecEasi author here.

I'm open to the idea of moving phyloseq to import, especially since this is one of the most common "errors" that is reported. Typically, installing phyloseq independently resolves the issue, but I've only dealt with local installations.

Since phyloseq is a large package, I wanted to avoid requiring a weighty install, since all I'm doing with the phyloseq objecting is grabbing the underlying data matrix in a wrapper function. Presumably, not everyone is using phyloseq. 

One thing I realized when reviewing this error now is that I have
import(phyloseq)

in my NAMESPACE file, which is triggered by a roxygen2 import, and is a mismatch of the DESCRIPTION file.

Would removing this explicit import be sufficient resolve the tangled dependency graph issue?


thanks.

parts:
It's a very testable thing without shinyapps.io being in the mix.
With no packages installed at all, install devtools, then install SpiecEasi.
Right now that blows up because of the lack of phyoseq.
If removing it from NAMESPACE enables that to succeed, then it will work in shinyapps.io.
